reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: What problem does Pete tell Anna about?
options: He does not have a job.
He has lost his driving license.
answers: He does not have a job.
questions.evidence: I do not have a job!
questions.explanation: Pete把I don’t have a job又清楚地重复为I do not have a job，说明问题是没有工作。后面谈到开车能力，不等于他丢了驾照；开场也没有说他找不到住处。不要把后续技能讨论移作最初的问题。

spokenEvidence.quote: I do not have a job!

questions.prompt: How does Anna try to help Pete find a suitable job?
options: She offers him a job at her office.
She asks questions about what he can do.
She tells him to move to another city.
answers: She asks questions about what he can do.
questions.evidence: Pete, I am good at asking questions. Let me ask you some.
questions.explanation: Anna先说明自己擅长提问，随后逐项问Can you write code、drive、teach、cook，用问题帮助Pete发现能力。她并没有直接给他办公室职位，也没有让他换城市。帮助方式与最终建议职业要分开理解。

spokenEvidence.quote: Pete, I am good at asking questions. Let me ask you some.

questions.prompt: What does Anna mean by writing code?
options: Creating instructions for apps or websites.
answers: Creating instructions for apps or websites.
questions.evidence: Code; you know, for making phone apps, or websites.
questions.explanation: Anna明确用making phone apps or websites解释code，指编程。Pete把code听成cold并拼字母，是对话里的误会，不是正确释义。写私人日记也不是她对这一技能的说明。

spokenEvidence.quote: Code; you know, for making phone apps, or websites.

questions.prompt: Why does Pete reject driving a taxi or a bus as a job?
options: He says he falls asleep when driving.
He says he cannot afford a race car.
He says he prefers to teach at school.
answers: He says he falls asleep when driving.
questions.evidence: No, I always fall asleep when I drive.
questions.explanation: Anna澄清问的是开出租车或公交车后，Pete给出的理由是开车时会睡着。赛车是他先前误解的问题，不是这里明确的拒绝理由；他也没有说自己更喜欢当老师。题目只核对角色说法，不提供驾驶建议。

spokenEvidence.quote: No, I always fall asleep when I drive.

questions.prompt: What makes Anna think Pete could earn money from writing?
options: He has already written a best-selling book.
His blog has a large number of followers.
He has taught writing for many years.
answers: His blog has a large number of followers.
questions.evidence:
Pete: I don’t know … 59,538.

Anna: Pete, that's a lot of followers! You can make money writing!
questions.explanation: Pete说自己的博客有59,538名关注者，Anna随即指出这很多，并建议靠写作挣钱。两句相连构成判断依据。文中没有畅销书或多年教写作经历，不能把职业成功的一般条件补成他已经具备的事实。

spokenEvidence.quote: Pete, that's a lot of followers! You can make money writing!

questions.prompt: Which career does Pete choose to pursue by the end?
questions.evidence: I’m going to be a writer!
questions.explanation: 结尾Pete亲口说I’m going to be a writer，确认自己打算当作家。chef和编程只是Anna探索技能时提过的工作，他已说自己不会做饭、不会编程；这些被讨论过的可能性不等于最终选择。

spokenEvidence.quote: I’m going to be a writer!

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item source comparison; not human or psychometric calibration

blindComparison.scope: Source text only; not an actual listening check, human examiner review or difficulty calibration.
